subject: Circle of Sages
text: Talking to the Circle of Sages results in one of them giving the party a Canoe.

evidence.quote: If you talk to them, they will tell you some information, mostly about the Orbs and a little about the Fiends, and one of them will give you a Canoe.

subject: Sorcerer
text: Sorcerers hit for 1-5 damage but possess a built-in Rub effect on attack that can slay a party member in a single hit regardless of anti-Rub spells or ProRings.

evidence.quote: Some like the Sorcerer can only hit for 1-5 damage or so, but he has a built in Rub on his attack, and can slay one of your party members in a single hit, even with anti-Rub spells and items like the ProRings.

subject: Floor B4
text: The middle treasure chest inside the room full of holes on Floor B4 contains the Floater.

evidence.quote:
Follow the single path down to the building, and you'll notice three 
treasure chests inside a room full of holes. The chest in the middle is
what everyone came down here for, for it contains the Floater.

subject: Floor B4
text: On Floor B4 of the Ice Cave, one of the three chests contains a Flame Sword.

evidence.quote:
For now,
get the Cloth, and drop it, and get the Flame Sword from the other
chest.

subject: Floor B4
text: On Floor B4 of the Ice Cave, the right treasure chest contains Cloth and triggers a mandatory fight with Mage enemies.

evidence.quote:
For future reference you
can avoid much pain and misery by avoiding the right treasure chest),
There is a fight in front of the chest every time, with Mage enemies.

subject: Freezing Ice
text: Freezing ice floor tiles deal 1 HP damage per step when walked across.

evidence.quote:
These is freezing ice
as I like to call it, and it will cause you damage each time you walk
across it, much like poison does, at 1 HP damage per step.

subject: Floor B5
text: Inside the western building on Floor B5, guarded by Frost Dragons, you will find Ice Armor and a Silver Gauntlet.

evidence.quote:
Inside you'll find your Ice Armor and a Silver
Gauntlet.

subject: Floor B5
text: A Silver Gauntlet is found inside the western building on Floor B5 of the Ice Cave.

evidence.quote:
Inside you'll find your Ice Armor and a Silver
Gauntlet.

subject: Floor B5
text: The southern building on Floor B5 contains chests with 9,900 GP, 5,000 GP, 12,350 GP, 7,900 GP, 5,450 GP, and 180 GP.

evidence.quote:
Enter the building
and collect the, 9,900 GP, 5,000 GP, 12,350 GP, 7,900 GP, 5,450 GP, and
180 GP.

subject: Floor B2
text: On Floor B2, following the path through the first building leads to a chest containing a Heal Potion.

evidence.quote:
First off, follow the path through the 
building and collect your Heal Potion, and head out the door.

subject: Floor B2
text: On Floor B2 of the Ice Cave, the building directly below the first one contains a chest with 10,000 GP.

evidence.quote:
Go around
to the next building just below the one you just exited, and get the
10,000 GP from the chest.

subject: Floor B2
text: The eastern building on Floor B2 contains chests with 9,500 GP, a Tent, and an Ice Shield.

evidence.quote:
Next, head to the east, and pick up the items
from the building over there. Get the 9,500 GP, Tent, and Ice Shield
from the chests.

subject: Eye
text: Eye has 162 HP and is weak to Fire and Harm spells.

evidence.quote:
Mini-Boss: Eye

HP: 162
Weakness: Fire, Harm

subject: Floater
text: Using the Floater anywhere in the small desert south of Crescent Lake causes the Airship to appear.

evidence.quote:
Now head back towards Crescent Lake, but keep going south to the
small desert. Get off your boat and use the Canoe to cross the river
until you are in the desert. It doesn't matter where you are in the
desert, but use your Floater, and the Airship will appear.

subject: Bahamut
text: Bahamut promises a reward if the party brings back proof of their courage.

evidence.quote:
If you manage to find Bahamut, he will tell you that if you can
bring back proof of your courage, he will reward you.

subject: Castle of Ordeal
text: Possession of the Crown is stated to be required to test your courage in the Castle of Ordeal.

evidence.quote:
He tells you that
poession of the Crown is required to test your courage.

subject: Floor 2
text: Navigating the pillar teleporter maze requires entering the bottom pillar when faced with top and bottom, the solo pillar, the bottom pillar at the southwestern corner, the south solo pillar, the right pillar at the northwestern corner, and finally the second pillar furthest down past the Zeus Gauntlet room to reach the staircase to Floor 3.

evidence.quote:
When there are two
pillars, one at the top and the other at the bottom of the room, enter
the bottom pillar, and then you'll be at a lone pillar, so enter that
one. You will now be at the southwestern corner of the room, with a
choice of of a top and bottom pillar to enter...while the
bottom pillar will lead to a new location. Follow the lone path on
which you just came all the way south to a solo pillar and enter it.
You will now be up in the northwestern corner of the floor, with two
more pillars to choose from, either right or left...where as the right pillar will lead
you further along in the maze...It is the second pillar and also the furthest one down from the
room with the Zeus Gauntlet in it...Upon entering the correct
pillar, you will be in the southeastern corner of the floor, next to a
staircase leading up to Floor 3.

subject: Floor 2
text: Inside the building on Floor 2 of Castle of Ordeal, fighting the MudGols yields the Zeus Gauntlet.

evidence.quote:
Enter the building and fight the MudGol(s) for
the Zeus Gauntlet which is a very useful item.

subject: Zeus Gauntlet
text: Using the Zeus Gauntlet in battle produces the effects of Lit2 and has infinite uses.

evidence.quote:
If you use the Zeus Gauntlet in battle
it will produce the same affects at Lit2, and it can be used
infinitely, which adds a little power to the White Mage.
